subject: do() in dplyr: doesn't work with functions nlsfit and goodness.of.fit

messages.author: c274c385266b9339
messages.subject: do() in dplyr: doesn't work with functions nlsfit and goodness.of.fit
parts:
Hi,

I am a very fond user of dplyr, and I discovered how to use the function do() within a chain of command to get coefficients of a lm model (for example: regr<-croissance_2014_2015%>%group_by(code)%>%filter(longueur!="NA")%>%do(tidy(lm(longueur~temp_sum,.)))

So I then tried to use the same kind of code, i.e. grouping by variables then applying a function, with two functions: nlsfit (package easynls) and goodness.of.fit (packge Zebook). It simply doesn't work with the nlsfit function, and with goodness.of.fit a value is returned but the grouping is not performed.

So before posting some code, I wanted to know: maybe not all functions can work within do() and only lm() and some others?

I could not find any hint on the internet so far.

thanks for the great dplyr package anyway,

cheers

Oswaldo

messages.subject: Re: do() in dplyr: doesn't work with functions nlsfit and goodness.of.fit

All functions should work, although some modelling functions have bugs
in them that are revealed when called this way.
Hadley
